review.images: Reviewed six gallery frames and the wide hero. The narrower duplicate entrance image was omitted. The daylight tower render supplies the card, with bedroom and living room views in the editorial panels.
review.location: Matched the published Golf Hillside map point, regional estate image and the four estimates on physical page 4 of the official brochure.
review.floorPlans: The developer PDF has one cover and 16 image-only sheets. Visually checked all complete drawings and transcribed the titles and sq ft area tables from the original pages, including both ends of the Type A4 range. Compared each printed total to the sum of its components and retained published rounding.

unavailable: Signed unit-specific sizes and entrance coordinates were not verified.
